name: devmagic-panel
description: Local WordPress control panel for Ubuntu/Debian: create sites from git and DB dumps, local SSL, Apache vhosts, WP core management, logs and cache tools, with an optional Claude assistant.

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning vitest run
scripts.lint:scripts: shellcheck -x install.sh get.sh scripts/package.sh scripts/bin/dmp-root scripts/bin/dmp-restore scripts/lib/*.sh && shellcheck -S error scripts/bin/wpcore
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.mockup: npm run build -w shared && npm run mockup -w web
scripts.build:demo: npm run build -w shared && npm run build:demo -w web && node scripts/demo/finish.mjs
scripts.screenshots: npm run build -w shared && node scripts/screenshots.mjs
